population: Only original ledger fold0 rows with source_known artist; preserve missing features and empty/null source tags. Recompute native connected components from numeric artist/album/duplicate groups and compare full ledger before selecting fold0. No outerfold fitting/scoring or outcome reads.

fold_rule.assignment: Held-out innerfold f; fit other4 innerfolds. Never stratify/reassign based on labels or realized sizes.

arms.recording_gaussian: Existing fit_positive_gaussian and score_positive_gaussian math on innerfit only; 44 unchanged columns.

component_gaussian.normalization: Each finite innerfit row gets1/(number of finite innerfit rows in its component); weighted population mean and variance. Zero variance columns inactive.
component_gaussian.positive_moments: For each label separately, each finite positive innerfit row gets1/(number of finite positive innerfit rows for that label in its component); every positive component has totalmass1. Compute class mean/variance usingthese labelconditionalweights after arm-specific trainnormalization.
component_gaussian.prior: Each source-known innerfit row including missing features gets1/(all innerfit rows in its component); prior=(weighted source-positive sum+.5)/(sum of all row weights+1).
component_gaussian.support: Same raw >=5finite positive training rows as recording arm; report distinct positive components and weighted support, do not introduce another gate.

arms.recording_popularity: Descending innerfit source-positive recording count including missing-feature rows; onlylabels withpositivecount>0; tiesascending nativegenreID; no descriptor abstention.

measurement.source_recall10: sum hits amongtop10 / all observed positives, including unmodeled labels and descriptor abstentions.
measurement.mrr: First matching positive reciprocalrank over entire supported labelranking; zero for missing/out-of-support/no-match. Standard mean over labeled queries.
measurement.positive_weighted_mrr: sum(num_source_positives_for_query * reciprocalrank)/sum sourcepositives, explicitly separate from conventional query-averageMRR.
measurement.coverage: nonemptyranking queries/allqueries; also labeled-only coverage. No-targetqueries retained for coverage/counts, excluded fromRecall/MRR denominators.
measurement.component_equal: For each component compute hits/positives, RRsum/labeledqueries and rankingqueries/allqueries; then mean correspondingdefined componentrates. No-targetcomponents excluded only fromRecall/MRR and counted.
measurement.primary: Pooled out-of-fold component-equalRecall10 difference balanced-minus-recordingGaussian. Allthree arms reported; noselectionthreshold orbestarm promotion. Component Recall10 means withincomponent positiveweightedrecovery hits/positives, not equalweight perqueryrecall; this exact estimand is intentional.
measurement.additional: Pooled positive-weightedRecall10, conventionalMRR, positive-weightedMRR, component-equalMRR, coverage, per-innerfold metrics and supports/abstentions.
measurement.uncertainty: 2000 paired component bootstrap draws with replacement from sorted pooled out-of-fold components, same sampled components acrossarms; PCG64 seed20261016; percentile2.5/97.5 via numpy linearquantile. Reportbalanced-minus-recording andbothGaussian-minus-popularity; ratio-of-resampledsums forweighted metrics, meanresampled componentrates forcomponent-equal. Conditional on fixed fivefits, NOT refit/bootstrap or confidence in novel corpus. Overlapping fourfold training sets induce dependence acrossOOF predictions; intervals are descriptive fixed-prediction resampling only, not independentfold populationinference or full trainingprocedure uncertainty.
measurement.support_ceiling: Perarm number/fraction of all OOF observed positives belonging to active labels in thatquerys innerfit; separate joint recoverablepositive ceiling also requiresquery descriptor/ranking support. Report allpositive denominator unchanged. Querycoverage nonemptyranking/allqueries; positivecoverage=sum positives of querieswithnonemptyranking/allpositives.
measurement.undefined_bootstrap: Any metric with zero denominator in a replicate is undefined; omit only from that metric quantile and report valid/undefined drawcounts; never reroll or zero-impute. Zero valid draws yields null interval.

preflight_concentration.report: Originaltrain allrow/finitefeature/labeledrow/positive masses percomponent: counts, largest/top5/top10 shares, inverseHerfindahl effectivecount; perlabel positive row/componentcounts and concentration; innerfold query/positive/finite counts. No change tofold/weighting based onthis.
preflight_concentration.giant_component: Report largest component nativeID, rows, positive mass, distinct artist and nonnull album counts; graph components are not individual artists; never split largest component.

stages.folds: 5 separate processes, eachonefold fitsbothGaussianarms and trainingpopularity then scoresonlythatinnerholdout; save models/ranks/percomponent sufficientstats
stages.summary: 1 process verifies5foldoutputs and computes pooledmetrics/bootstrap; no fit
stages.replay: independent separate bounded verification of nativeweighted moments/ranks/denominators andbootstrap

interpretation: Exploratory training-only CV design chosen after prior outerfold inspection; those inspected outerfolds are not used here.
Source-positive annotation recovery, not musical similarity/relevance or calibrated genre probabilities.
Component balancing is a bundled change to normalization, positive moments and prior; no causal attribution to one subchange.
Components encode artist/album/exact-feature identity links, not proven independent musicians or musical units.
No serving replacement, new data/audio, model tuning or learned embedding.
execution_seal: After independentprotocolreview, freeze exactfinalprotocol+producer/helpercode hashes before model outcomes. Preserve any supersededproposal.

supersedes.reason: Pre-outcome design clarification: equal positive component mass within each label; preserve shared raw5-row support gate to isolate weighting; clarify denominators and conditional uncertainty.

label_universe: All164 native genre IDs in verified numeric genre metadata, sortedascending; no outcome-driven label selection.
low_component_support: Forbotharms report eachlabel finitepositive rowcount anddistinctpositivecomponentcount; identify active labels supportedby<5components without gating them out.
